mapper.select: select coalesce((select coin_balance from eng_user_coin_wallet where user_id=#{userId}),0)
mapper.insert: insert into eng_user_coin_wallet(user_id,coin_balance,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time) values(#{userId},#{coinReward},#{username},now(),#{username},now()) on duplicate key update coin_balance=coin_balance+values(coin_balance), update_by=values(update_by), update_time=values(update_time)
